findings.passage: “While I understand and support efforts to deter voter fraud, the state has demonstrated an inability to ensure individuals have access to the proper ID.
findings.note: Statement issued in her name on a court delaying the 2012 photo ID law, carried in full by Patch (posted 2012-10-03, statement made the Tuesday before).

findings.passage: “When the Senate approved the Voter ID legislation in March, I stood up on the Senate floor and offered an amendment to delay implementation of the law.
findings.note: She says she offered a floor amendment to delay the 2012 ID law to give voters time to obtain ID.

findings.passage: Finally, SB 421 would create a no excuse mail-in voting option for all Pennsylvania voters.
findings.note: Release in her name (she was prime sponsor of SB 421). It does not mention ID. Saved as related mail-ballot material; the quoted sentence is the release's summary, not a direct quote of her.

findings.passage: “At a time when the integrity of our elections is under constant attack from extremists who want to end vote-by-mail the last thing we need to do is hand them more rhetorical ammunition courtesy of this careless error by our county leadership.
findings.note: Joint statement issued by six Lehigh County legislators on an error that sent incorrect vote-by-mail ballots for the May 19 primary. About mail ballot accuracy, not ID. Posted on a co-signer's House page.
